subject: FastPath SI onboarding: hybrid training & sandbox access
messages:
From: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@blueridge.consulting>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Vega <sofia.vega@blueridge.consulting>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FastPath SI onboarding: training proposal and access

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the intro — Blue Ridge is excited to get started on the FastPath SI partnership. We put together a short ask and proposed format so we can lock dates:

- Goal: certify two lead consultants and enable 6-8 delivery engineers to run joint POCs with Redwood models.
- Format: hybrid (remote technical lab + optional 1/2 day in-person enablement at our SF office).
- Proposed dates: Aug 17-18 for the remote labs, Aug 31 (optional in-person).
- Needs from Redwood: temporary sandbox with sample datasets, an API key scoped for Sandbox (non-prod), an integration checklist, and a short solution brief for sales motions.

Can you confirm availability and next steps? Attendees from our side: Jordan Mills (engagement lead), Sofia Vega (solution architect). We can share a PO once we agree on dates and a short Statement of Work.

Attachments: initial_requirements.docx (outline)

Thanks,
Jordan Mills
Senior Partnerships Manager
Blue Ridge Consulting
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@blueridge.consulting>, Sofia Vega <sofia.vega@blueridge.consulting>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FastPath SI onboarding: training proposal and access

Jordan — great to hear, and thanks for the clear asks. We can support the hybrid plan. High level next steps from our side:

1) Laura will own the syllabus and lab content (cc'd).
2) Dylan will provision a scoped sandbox and temporary API key; he'll confirm network and data constraints.
3) I'll coordinate schedules and milestone sign-off (certification criteria, PO, SOW).

Proposed immediate dates look good on our side (Aug 17-18). If Blue Ridge wants the Aug 31 in-person, we can provision a small on-site budget for an enablement day — we should finalize by Aug 10.

Can you confirm the attendee list and whether you need SOC2 evidence / a short security slide for procurement? That will help us loop Security early.

I'll attach a short checklist we use for SI ramp.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Partner Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-si-fastpath-checklist.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@blueridge.consulting>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: FastPath syllabus draft and hands-on lab outline

Hi Jordan — looping in a draft syllabus so Blue Ridge can confirm scope and learning outcomes. Short version below; PDF attached with exercises and time estimates (fastpath-syllabus-v1.pdf).

Day 1 (remote):
- 09:00 - 09:30 Intro to Redwood serving runtime and deployment modes (hosted / dedicated / private)
- 09:30 - 11:00 API walkthrough: generation, streaming, embeddings, reranking (live calls to sandbox)
- 11:15 - 12:30 Hands-on lab 1: model selection & quantization tradeoffs
- 13:30 - 16:30 Lab 2: end-to-end integration (client SDK + retry/fallback patterns)

Day 2 (remote):
- 09:00 - 10:30 Production playbooks: batching, caching, and cost controls
- 10:45 - 12:00 Observability & rollouts: console walkthrough and evals integration
- 13:00 - 15:30 Advanced lab: private deployment checklist + mock canary rollout
- 15:30 - 16:00 Certification exam / checklist review

Ask: please confirm the attendee technical level (senior engineer vs. delivery consultant) and whether you want the optional in-person session to focus on sales enablement or deeper hands-on delivery labs.

Attachment: fastpath-syllabus-v1.pdf

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Developer Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@blueridge.consulting>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FastPath SI onboarding: training proposal and access

Jordan — quick infra note from my side:

- I will provision a dedicated sandbox project with a scoped API key (expires 30 days after onboarding; can extend with request).
- Sandbox will include 2 GPU-backed endpoints (small-medium) and a shared S3-like bucket for sample data.
- Link to ephemeral API onboarding runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/fastpath-sandbox-onboard (internal)

Security: if you need SOC2 artifacts, please state specific artifacts (control descriptions, logs retention). Security will produce a redacted packet for vendor procurement — expect a 3-5 business day turnaround.

I'll create the sandbox creds and post in a secure share once SOW or PO is received.

Regards,
Dylan Brooks
Staff Infra Engineer, Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachment: api-integration-checklist.xlsx
From: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@blueridge.consulting>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FastPath SI onboarding: training proposal and access

Thanks everyone — this is perfect. Confirming attendees:
- Jordan Mills (Engagement Lead)
- Sofia Vega (Solution Architect)
- Marcus Lee (Delivery Engineer)

We prefer the in-person day to focus on joint sales enablement (two customer-facing playbook sessions) followed by a half-day deep-dive for Marcus. We'll send a PO by Aug 7.

For SOC2, procurement wants the standard vendor packet (Type II summary, high-level control matrix, and contact for audit requests). Sofia will follow up with the exact procurement email.

Also: what does certification mean for Blue Ridge consultants? Laura — can you confirm the checklist pass criteria so we can share internally?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to Aug 17.

Best,
Jordan Mills
Senior Partnerships Manager
Blue Ridge Consulting
